tier1.text: Each median cubital vein is a surface vein that links the cephalic vein to the basilic vein. The cephalic vein drains blood from the surface of the arm. The basilic vein is a surface vein that runs up into the upper arm. The median cubital vein crosses at a slant between these two veins.
